The '''''Krakana''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Twenty-Ninth Fleet]]. It was under the command of [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Dol Narlock]].<ref name="Narlock Codex" />

==History==
In the year [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref> during the [[third Galactic War]], the ''Krakana'' stopped at [[Mek-Sha]] along with the rest of the Twenty-Ninth Fleet on their way to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to aid in the defense of the [[Meridian Complex]]. However, while on Mek-Sha, it was [[Mission to Mek-Sha|targeted]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which aimed to destroy it and the fleet so that it could not be able to continue on to Corellia.<ref name="GangsOfMekSha">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|The Gangs of Mek-Sha|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught}}
However, the Empire's plans to destroy the ship were stopped by the [[Alliance Commander]], who battled through the Empire's forces, including [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tarnux]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]], and saved the fleet as well as the ''Krakana''.<ref name="DefendingTheDocks">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Defending the Docks|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

Following this, the ''Krakana'' arrived to defend against the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|attack]] on the Meridian Complex, and helped to successfully fight off the Imperial Fleets.<ref name="Objective Meridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Objective Meridian}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Krakana'' appears alongside the Twenty-Ninth Fleet during the '''Onslaught''' expansion for the game '''Star Wars: The Old Republic''', and is mentioned by name in a codex entry for Vice Admiral Narlock. If the player character is a Republic Loyalist or an Imperial Saboteur, they will save the ''Krakana'' from being destroyed by the Empire. However, if the player character is an Imperial Loyalist or a Republic Saboteur, they will successfully destroy the ''Krakana'' and prevent it from being present during the defense of the Meridian Complex.
